cohort: Women undergoing term, uncomplicated cesarean births
finding: This pilot study suggests that removing the placenta before cord clamping to allow for at least 3 minutes of DCC during term, uncomplicated cesarean births is feasible and safe, with high maternal satisfaction and clinician comfort.
mod_finding: This method of DCC in cesarean birth appears feasible and safe in this small pilot study and was associated with high maternal satisfaction and clinician comfort.
